name: Bingles' Hammer
summary: Troggs have taken Bingles' Hammer from the crash site in Loch Modan. Bingles Blastenheimer, a stranded gnome aviator, needs his specialized gear to repair his flying machine and help free Gnomeregan.

sections.title: A Stranded Aviator's Toolkit
sections.body: Bingles Blastenheimer survived his flying machine's plunge into the Loch, then lost his tools to troggs on the freshwater islands. They took his hammer and high-potency explosives from the crash site. He needs the hammer to repair the dented airframe and adjust the gyrocopter's mechanical parts. Without his equipment, Bingles cannot fly support runs for the gnome forces fighting to reclaim Gnomeregan.

faq.q: Where can Bingles' Hammer be found?
faq.answer: Bingles' Hammer is inside one of Bingles's Toolbuckets scattered across the trogg-infested islands in the northern Loch.

faq.q: Who does this hammer belong to?
faq.answer: The hammer belongs to Bingles Blastenheimer, a gnome engineer and pilot whose flying machine crashed along the shores of Loch Modan.

faq.q: Why is this tool so important to Bingles?
faq.answer: Bingles needs his full set of tools to rebuild his downed gyrocopter. He plans to fly it in battle against the troggs and leper gnomes occupying Gnomeregan.
Troggs living on the lake islands raided the crash site and took Bingles' toolbuckets and custom blastencapper explosives.

angles.text: As a gnome, each recovered tool brings the airborne assault to free your ancestral home closer.
As an engineer, you know a fine gnome-crafted hammer is hard to replace, especially when rebuilding an experimental gyrocopter in the wilderness.
